I will go to the cooperative to get what fertilizer I can, though I know it may come late and might not be enough. I have saved my own seed from last year's harvest because buying improved seed is too expensive, and I have some cattle manure that I will spread on the field before planting. This plot is small enough that my family can do most of the work, but I will need to hire a few extra hands when the weeding and harvesting come, as the timing is tight.
